acceptance_predicates.description: The ASB development broker frontend remains in its private ASB-owned process group and that exact group owns the caller's controlling terminal foreground for the interactive lifetime.
The exact validated prior foreground process group is restored after every successful or failed development broker lifetime without leaving ASB or its caller stopped in the background.
Timeout, handshake, server, spawn, and frontend failures still terminate and reap the child process group and descendants, join workers, and remove private broker state.
The repair uses safe Rust interfaces, preserves forbid(unsafe_code), and does not change stable or production launch semantics.
A focused test establishes a real controlling PTY and exercises launch_development_broker_with_backend, proving child foreground ownership and parent foreground restoration.

definition_of_done: The signed and DCO-certified implementation is independently reviewed and merged on protected ASB main.
Focused controlling-PTY broker tests and full relevant ASB tests pass at the exact reviewed head.
All required hosted checks and post-merge main checks are terminal green, after which asb-tui AR-1654 can be requalified.

gates.description: The actual development broker path passes under a real controlling PTY and restores the prior foreground group.
Existing and new descendant/process-group cleanup regressions pass.
Independent exact-head review, required PR checks, signed merge integrity, and post-merge checks pass.
